_about: Frame-review checklist for scorecard v2. status: open | review (fixed in code, not yet seen in frames; still counts as open) | closed (seen fixed, evidence given). severity: high | medium | low. Seeded from the 2026-11-11 full-game review (D:/TAGFullGame).

checks.title: Get-offs from the wrong side's pool (C fires off with a DL clip, DL with an OL pass-set or a guard pull)
checks.evidence: p5: role_mismatch off_dl_clip 0, def_ol_clip 0 (get-off pools by job)

checks.title: Kick returner sprints in the crouched comeback-catch clip
checks.evidence: p5 c001 f120-138: comeback catch clip ends 0.5 s after the catch, then MM run (one-shot catch exit)

checks.title: No touchdown celebrations (183 clips loaded, none played)
checks.evidence: p5: 2 of 2 touchdowns celebrated (team celebration, telemetry clip:*Celeb*)

checks.evidence: p7: role_mismatch armsup_on_run 0 (was 2914 frames in p5)

checks.evidence: line test 12 Nov (tag_linetest_047-071): hands to the chest plate, upper bodies clear (ResolveEngagedOverlap: chest 52 cm, helmet-to-chest 38 cm for any two standing men); the pancake finish (035) still overlaps as the end goes down: under int_pile_limbs

checks.evidence: p5 telemetry: kickers wear #6 / #10, punters #1 / #16 (K/P ranges 1-19, kick units start with the real K)

checks.title: Crowd near the sideline reads as low-detail cards in close shots
checks.evidence: p44 c059 f20 / f60, p41 c020 f10 (15 Nov): the lower bowl behind the benches is the pack's fan models, standing figures in both teams' colours; only the upper deck, which no sideline shot gets close to, is still cards | 17 Nov: behind the end zones too - the painted crowd sat right behind every touchdown close-up (rows of orange discs). Pack fans now fill 8 rows behind each end zone (on the seating steps past the 3 on the plain slope) and 3 along the sidelines: 1265 fans, 114 fps at 1080p (bench, seed 7; 485 fans 111 before), touchdown close-up endf8 c013 f415 a real crowd. -TagEndRows=N / -TagFanRows=N | then the whole front: sidelines the full straight run (they stopped at the 16s), the four corner arcs 3 rows (-TagCornerRows=N): 1951 fans, 111 fps (1% low 66 against 78), fanfull c013: fans along the whole wall in every shot; above ~8 rows the painted crowd | and the painted crowd itself redrawn (gen_textures.py crowd(): clothing-led, small heads under hair and caps, shoulders and arms, dark seat rows; it had big bare skin-tone heads a quarter of a seat wide): crowd2 c013 f300-415, the upper rows read as a packed crowd in team colours, no discs, no frame cost

checks.title: Chain-crew rods render as a slanted orange bar
checks.evidence: p41 c003 f10, c010 f10 (15 Nov): upright sticks with their orange markers on the far sideline at the line to gain and the down marker; the pack chain crew's own slanted prop stripped from the mesh

checks.title: Officials' uniforms: no numbers, the referee's white cap
checks.evidence: ref2 c003 f30 (14 Nov): the referee in a white cap with R 85 on his back, the crew in the pack's black caps with their own patches (DJ 28 ...), from the pack's referee_numbers textures; trousers and shoes on their own map (they were drawn from the accessories map: yellow shoes, blue shins)

checks.title: Referee lines up 2-4 yd from the QB and ends up in the sack pile
checks.evidence: p10 telemetry (refw): the referee within 1 m of a player in 0.4% of live frames (28 of 7,000) from his station 12 yd deep, 5.5 yd wide; no longer in sack piles

checks.title: Officials walk through players
checks.evidence: p13 telemetry: no official closer than 42 cm to any player all game (bodies never overlap); within 1 m in 0.32% of frames, mostly the referee taking the ball (OfficialDodge + OfficialPushOut)

checks.title: One on-field official instead of a seven-man crew
checks.evidence: p7 c021 f80, c007 f205: striped crew on the field (wings on the sidelines, deep men downfield) besides the referee

checks.title: Forearms, elbows and legs can still pass through another body in a pile
checks.evidence: 15 Nov: hands are now kept out of the heads, chests and hips of the men a player is down with (arm IK, FTagRetargetProxy::ApplyKeepOut). Measured in the game (TAG limb clip log): a hand more than 3 cm inside another body in 0.09% of pile pair-frames over a full game (p49, 11 of 12,044), 0.31% over the same first 25 clips without it (k0). Not handled or measured: elbows, legs, and the pancake finish of line test 035 | 16 Nov: legs added to the pile keep-out (a down man's foot and shin pushed out of the heads, chests and hips of the men down with him, leg IK). 24-play A/B (-TagNoKeepOut): a hand inside another body 0.50% -> 0.13% of pile pair-frames, a foot 0.35% -> 0.26%, 0 pops | 16 Nov night: elbows and knees measured (TAG limb clip log, 24 plays lc1): an elbow inside another body 0.18% of pile pair-frames, a knee 0.55%; swinging the IK bend away from the body (elbow pole, knee bend) did not move either (lc2: 0.17%, 0.61%) and was taken out - the overlap is not the bend

checks.title: Linemen block 65 yd downfield on a breakaway
checks.evidence: 200 headless games: deepest engaged OL block 16 yd (was 48); SimTests leash

checks.title: Coverage too loose at 10-19 yd after the movement limits (separation 3.2-3.6 yd)
checks.evidence: SimCalibrate 200 games (14 Nov): separation at the catch 10-19 yd 3.00 yd, every target at the ball's arrival 3.30 (was 3.94 / 3.70): zone defenders read the quarterback's eyes and break at the release, man coverage plays tighter

checks.evidence: p1 filmed game went through halftime on its own (commit 8e89838)

checks.title: Men still walking at the snap (illegal motion, teleport)
checks.evidence: p1: plays with a pop 61 -> 3, none at the snap

checks.title: Facemask tackle clips used as clean tackles, never flagged
checks.evidence: p5 telemetry: no Facemask/HorseCollar tackle clip played (only WR presnap fidgets); facemask now a sim foul on the tackler

checks.title: The rush on a kick is not played: blocks are a probability on field goals, and punts are never blocked
checks.evidence: 15 Nov: the main part is closed - field goals and extra points are played (leg and line drawn, the ball flown with drag, good only over the bar between the uprights; 84% over four seeds), punts fly a solved drag flight to a spot drawn from the punter's leg, and the operation on all three is the pack's captures with both lines set and blocking (fg3 c002, p41 c050, p43 c033). What is left is the rush itself, about 1% of kicks | 16 Nov night: the rush on a blocked kick is played (kb1, -TagTune=kickBlock=1): on a field goal the edge man plays Madden's FG block capture (FGBlock_Left_Edge_Block_v2__P03) from the snap, turned so his layout lands at the holder as the foot comes through (lined up 6.8 yd wide), the ball popping off him; on a punt the middle rusher runs in clean and lays out at the punter's foot (the same capture's layout). A blocked punt used to be drawn as a full 40-yard punt: it now pops up short to where it is recovered, the coverage still releasing and the line staying on its blocks

checks.title: Penalties are dice rolls, not from what happens on the field
checks.evidence: p7 log: "PENALTY on OKC: Offensive Holding (#78 K.Blackwell)" - fouls from PlayResult risks, called on the man

checks.evidence: p10 c016: game clock 3:57 -> 3:27 with the play clock :37 -> :07 through the pre-snap (running clock); c013 after an incompletion: game clock held 4:56, play clock :37 -> :16

checks.title: Kicked balls (punt/FG/PAT) fly on a scripted arc
checks.evidence: p7 c049 f60: the PAT high over the bar on the solved drag flight; punts land on the sim spot

checks.title: Stale HUD: '1st & 10' on kickoffs, 'KICKOFF' on a PAT, a flag line through the next play
checks.evidence: p7 c049 f60: EXTRA POINT down box, score held at 6 with the kick in the air; KICKOFF on kickoffs

checks.title: Camera lags the ball on long runs (tackle at the frame edge)
checks.evidence: p7: carrier inside the safe frame in 99.8% of 6287 live frames

checks.title: Kick result text floats in the scene
checks.evidence: p7 c051 f15: no text over the field on the play after a PAT

checks.title: No first-down line or play-clock graphic
checks.evidence: p7 frames: yellow first-down line and the play clock beside the down box (:39 / :37)

checks.title: No stat overlays after big plays
checks.evidence: 16 Nov, 1080p film c016 (16-yd TD pass): a lower third above the score bar from the whistle for 4 s ('#89 R. Ochoa | 2 REC, 25 YDS, 1 TD'), the score bar 6-0 with TOUCHDOWN in the down box through the cut-in and the replay. Before: the line sat over the field for 0.5 s of film (the overlay timed on the wall clock, ticked twice a frame) and the bug read 0-0, 3rd & 5 until the play was applied
